text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a strong four-day rally that's added about $6 to the stock since Monday. The move reflects a broader lift in oil majors after crude prices stabilized—US oil is trading around $89.60 per barrel, and the stock has climbed steadily as energy markets steadied following recent weakness. The heating oil spike (up 59% from last winter) signals sustained demand for refined products heading into winter, which supports the refining side of integrated oil companies like ConocoPhillips.

The rally sits against a backdrop of tightening global oil supply dynamics, at least temporarily. Russian crude production rebounded to 8.73 million barrels per day in October, but the recent recovery in Gulf exports—part of the broader Trump diesel deal mentioned in the news—has kept international oil markets in flux rather than creating a glut, meaning crude prices have held their ground rather than collapsing.
